Skills-lane self-triage (run-to-empty fire): `finding` → **`pm:queue`**. Fact 2 (ccd hosts lack the fuse's `get_session` reading; the transcript-JSONL `"model":` field is the valid host-authored substitute, own-session only) is distinct and bankable as-is. Fact 1 (REST pool survives GraphQL exhaustion) lands **qualified** per #11835 — REST availability is per-session and must be probed, so the fact reads "on sessions where REST is enabled, the pools are separate and the dispatch loop can finish on REST; the GraphQL-only mutations (`gh pr ready`, auto-merge) wait for reset". Fold: one platform-readings consolidation PR with #11577 + #11835 + #11604's fact items — the four cards' facts touch the same file and several qualify each other, so landing them separately would write contradictions.

Measured substitute reading for the contract-review fuse, on a ccd/web host (2026-08-25, session `session_01Pqy1DfKRHo8DU67Rpvmmt1`): `mcp__Claude_Code_Remote__get_session` with `session_id` omitted returns both `session_context.model` and `external_metadata.last_served_model` — machine-readable, no GraphQL involved. This session read `claude-fable-5` on both keys and the triage auto-adjudication gate armed on it (first machine-verified arming after four rounds skipped as "not machine-readable in this environment"). One leg still unmeasured: whether the claude-code-remote MCP server (and thus this tool) is present on *scheduled-fire* sessions — the sessions that recorded the skip should re-test this exact call. Evidence appended to this card rather than filed new (dedup: this thread is the open home for the fuse-reading gap).
